notes_for_editor: The register page is detailed: built 1934, burned after 1968, nothing remains. The Forest Lookouts page supplies the only staffing name (Leo Chatfield, 1936, via a California Ranger item). That page also prints a November 2, 1959 Appeal-Democrat item about a Tahoe fire that burned 'several buildings and a lookout station'. The item does not name Alaska Peak, so it is left out of the story; an editor should check whether it refers to this site. The record's 'removed 1968' event is a simplification: the register says 'removed after 1968' in its field and 'burned in a wildfire after 1968' in its description, so the event type should be 'burned'. This is noted, not proposed as a correction. Public access is not stated in any source; the story says so. The register's 1939 and 1968 photos are credited (Mark Swift Collection; Michael Szyhowski) but their image URLs were not captured, so none are listed under photos. No other source was read; one search returned only Calpine Lookout pages, which are a different site.
